fcdo.title: UK Government foreign travel advice (Open Government Licence v3.0)

entry.en: Your passport must expire at least 6 months after the date you arrive in the Philippines.
entry.es: Tu pasaporte debe caducar al menos 6 meses después de tu fecha de llegada a Filipinas.
entry.quote: To enter the Philippines, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive.

entry.en: You must have a QR code showing you registered on the e-travel system within the 72 hours before arriving in the Philippines.
entry.es: Debes tener un código QR que demuestre que te registraste en el sistema e-travel en las 72 horas previas a tu llegada a Filipinas.
entry.quote: You must have a QR code to show that you have registered on the e-travel system within the 72 hours before your arrival in the Philippines.

entry.en: Most UK visitors are also expected to have proof of return or onward travel.
entry.es: Se espera que la mayoría de los visitantes del Reino Unido también tengan comprobante de viaje de regreso o de continuación.
entry.quote: Most UK visitors are also expected to have proof of return or onward travel.

entry.en: You cannot take in more than 50,000 Philippine pesos.
entry.es: No puedes introducir más de 50.000 pesos filipinos.
entry.quote: You cannot take in more than 50,000 Philippine pesos.

entry.en: A yellow fever vaccination certificate is required if you are coming from a country listed as a transmission risk.
entry.es: Se exige certificado de vacunación contra la fiebre amarilla si vienes de un país catalogado como de riesgo de transmisión.
entry.quote: a yellow fever vaccination if you’re coming from a country listed as a transmission risk

safety.en: FCDO advises against all travel to western and central Mindanao and the Sulu archipelago.
safety.es: El FCDO desaconseja todo viaje al oeste y centro de Mindanao y al archipiélago de Sulú.
safety.quote: FCDO advises against all travel to western and central Mindanao and the Sulu archipelago.

safety.en: There are high levels of street crime and robbery, sometimes involving weapons and firearms.
safety.es: Hay altos niveles de delincuencia callejera y robos, a veces con armas y armas de fuego.
safety.quote: There are high levels of street crime and robbery, sometimes involving weapons and firearms.

safety.en: If you travel by taxi, including to or from the airport, only use taxis from a reputable company.
safety.es: Si viajas en taxi, también hacia o desde el aeropuerto, usa solo taxis de una empresa de confianza.
safety.quote: If you’re travelling by taxi, including to or from the airport, only use taxis from a reputable company.

safety.en: Around 20 typhoons hit the Philippines each year, mostly between June and November.
safety.es: Unos 20 tifones azotan Filipinas cada año, la mayoría entre junio y noviembre.
safety.quote: Around 20 typhoons hit the Philippines each year. Most typhoons happen between June and November.

safety.en: The Philippines Bureau of Immigration has warned foreign nationals against taking part in public protests and political rallies.
safety.es: La Oficina de Inmigración de Filipinas ha advertido a los extranjeros que no participen en protestas públicas ni mítines políticos.
safety.quote: The Philippines Bureau of Immigration has warned foreign nationals against participating in public protests and political rallies.

safety.en: Road accidents happen frequently, mainly due to poor road conditions, dangerous driving and non-enforcement of traffic laws.
safety.es: Los accidentes de tráfico son frecuentes, principalmente por el mal estado de las carreteras, la conducción peligrosa y la falta de cumplimiento de las normas.
safety.quote: Accidents happen frequently, mainly due to poor road conditions, dangerous driving and non-enforcement of traffic laws.

health.en: Mosquito-borne diseases are a risk all year, with a heightened dengue risk in the rainy season from June to October.
health.es: Las enfermedades transmitidas por mosquitos son un riesgo todo el año, con mayor riesgo de dengue en la temporada de lluvias de junio a octubre.
health.quote: Mosquito-borne diseases are a risk all year round. However, there’s a heightened risk of dengue during the rainy season from June to October.

health.en: Medical care varies across the Philippines and may not meet UK standards, particularly in rural and remote areas.
health.es: La atención médica varía en Filipinas y puede no alcanzar los estándares del Reino Unido, sobre todo en zonas rurales y remotas.
health.quote: The availability of medical care varies across the Philippines and may not meet the standards of care in the UK, particularly in rural and remote areas.

health.en: Private hospital treatment and medical transport are expensive, with intensive care costing more than £1,000 a day.
health.es: El tratamiento en hospitales privados y el transporte médico son caros, con cuidados intensivos de más de 1.000 libras al día.
health.quote: Private hospital treatment and medical transport is expensive – the daily cost in intensive care units can be more than £1,000.

health.en: Wikivoyage advises drinking bottled water, and says buko juice is also safe if no local ice has been added.
health.es: Wikivoyage aconseja beber agua embotellada y dice que el jugo de buko también es seguro si no se le ha añadido hielo local.
health.quote: Drink the readily available bottled water. Buko juice (coconut water) is also safe if they have not added local ice to it.

health.en: Wikivoyage says rabies is common among street animals in the Philippines and advises getting a rabies vaccination.
health.es: Wikivoyage dice que la rabia es común entre los animales callejeros de Filipinas y aconseja vacunarse contra ella.
health.quote: Rabies is also common among street animals in the Philippines, so get a vaccination for rabies if you haven't already

health.en: Wikivoyage says hepatitis A, B and C is endemic and common in the country.
health.es: Wikivoyage dice que la hepatitis A, B y C es endémica y común en el país.
health.quote: Hepatitis A, B and C is endemic and common in the country.

help.en: The emergency number for ambulance, fire and police is 911.
help.es: El número de emergencias para ambulancia, bomberos y policía es el 911.

help.en: You can call FCDO in London for urgent help if something has happened to a friend or relative abroad.
help.es: Puedes llamar al FCDO en Londres para pedir ayuda urgente si algo le ha pasado a un amigo o familiar en el extranjero.
help.quote: You can call FCDO in London if you need urgent help because something has happened to a friend or relative abroad.

help.en: Wikivoyage lists a tourist hotline at +63 2 524-1728 and 524-1660.
help.es: Wikivoyage indica una línea de atención al turista en el +63 2 524-1728 y 524-1660.

getting_in.en: Most visitors fly in through Ninoy Aquino International Airport (NAIA, MNL) in Metro Manila.
getting_in.es: La mayoría de los visitantes llega en avión por el Aeropuerto Internacional Ninoy Aquino (NAIA, MNL) en Metro Manila.
getting_in.quote: Most visitors entering the Philippines will fly in through the Ninoy Aquino International Airport (NAIA) (MNL IATA) in Metro Manila.

getting_in.en: Mactan-Cebu International Airport (CEB) in Metro Cebu is the second-busiest airport in the Philippines.
getting_in.es: El Aeropuerto Internacional Mactan-Cebú (CEB) en Metro Cebú es el segundo más concurrido de Filipinas.
getting_in.quote: Mactan-Cebu International Airport (CEB IATA) in Metro Cebu is the Philippines' second-busiest airport.

getting_in.en: Clark International Airport (CRK) in Angeles City, 85 km north of Manila, is a popular hub for low-cost carriers.
getting_in.es: El Aeropuerto Internacional de Clark (CRK), en Angeles City, 85 km al norte de Manila, es un centro popular de aerolíneas de bajo coste.
getting_in.quote: Clark International Airport (CRK IATA) in Angeles City 85 km north of Manila is a popular hub for low-cost carriers serving Manila

getting_in.en: The Philippines is mostly reachable only by plane, even from within Southeast Asia.
getting_in.es: A Filipinas casi solo se llega en avión, incluso desde dentro del Sudeste Asiático.
getting_in.quote: As an island nation separated by thousands of kilometers of seas, the Philippines is mostly reachable only by plane even from within Southeast Asia.

getting_in.en: Airlines may refuse check-in if you only have a one-way ticket to the Philippines.
getting_in.es: Las aerolíneas pueden negarse a facturarte si solo tienes un billete de ida a Filipinas.
getting_in.quote: Airlines may refuse to let you check in if you only have a one-way ticket to the Philippines due to immigration requirements.

getting_around.en: Travel by plane and boat is very important for most visitors, especially between major cities.
getting_around.es: Viajar en avión y barco es muy importante para la mayoría de los visitantes, sobre todo entre las grandes ciudades.
getting_around.quote: The country's vast archipelagic nature makes travel by plane and boat very important for most visitors, especially between major cities.

getting_around.en: The Beep card is used on the Manila LRT and MRT, as well as city buses and modern jeepneys in Manila and Cebu City.
getting_around.es: La tarjeta Beep se usa en el LRT y MRT de Manila, y también en autobuses urbanos y jeepneys modernos de Manila y Cebú.
getting_around.quote: Beep is originally used on the Manila LRT and MRT, but is also used to pay for city buses and modern jeepneys in Manila and Cebu City, and can also be used with certain merchants.

getting_around.en: In large cities, a habal-habal can be hailed through apps such as Angkas, Grab Bike and JoyRide.
getting_around.es: En las grandes ciudades se puede pedir un habal-habal con apps como Angkas, Grab Bike y JoyRide.
getting_around.quote: In large cities, it is possible to hail a habal-habal through apps such as Angkas, Grab Bike and JoyRide.

getting_around.en: You may book a taxi with apps such as Grab or Easy Taxi for a small fee on top of the metered fare.
getting_around.es: Puedes reservar un taxi con apps como Grab o Easy Taxi por una pequeña tarifa adicional sobre el taxímetro.
getting_around.quote: You may book a taxi using GPS enabled mobile apps such as Grab or Easy Taxi for a small fee on top of the metered fare.

getting_around.en: Bus, train and ferry schedules are on Maps, but bus and ferry schedules are hardly reliable or up to date.
getting_around.es: Los horarios de autobús, tren y ferri están en Maps, pero los de autobuses y ferris apenas son fiables o actuales.
getting_around.quote: Bus, train, and ferry schedules can also be found through Maps, but schedules for buses or ferries are hardly reliable or barely up-to-date.

getting_around.en: A tricycle or a jeepney will usually be both safer and more comfortable, if you have the choice.
getting_around.es: Si puedes elegir, un triciclo o un jeepney suele ser más seguro y cómodo.
getting_around.quote: If you have a choice, either a tricycle or a jeepney will usually be both safer and more comfortable.

money.en: The Philippine peso (PHP) is the official currency and the only one used for most transactions.
money.es: El peso filipino (PHP) es la moneda oficial y la única usada en la mayoría de las transacciones.
money.quote: The Philippine peso (or piso), ISO code: PHP, is the official currency and is the only currency used for most transactions.

money.en: The Philippines is fundamentally a cash-only society, and carrying ₱1,000 bills for larger purchases is fine but risky.
money.es: Filipinas es fundamentalmente una sociedad de efectivo, y llevar billetes de ₱1.000 para compras mayores es válido pero arriesgado.
money.quote: The Philippines is fundamentally a cash-only society; it's just fine to carry stacks of ₱1,000 bills for medium to large purchases, though it's also risky.

money.en: US dollars may be accepted in some circumstances, but you should not count on them even for high-end big-ticket items.
money.es: Los dólares estadounidenses pueden aceptarse en algunas circunstancias, pero no cuentes con ellos ni para artículos caros.
money.quote: U.S. dollars may be accepted in some circumstances (particularly to buy international flights and perform some e-commerce transactions), but don't count on it to buy even high-end big ticket items.

money.en: Tipping is not always expected because a mandatory service charge of 8–12% is added to restaurant or hotel bills.
money.es: No siempre se espera propina porque se añade un cargo por servicio obligatorio del 8–12% a las cuentas de restaurantes y hoteles.
money.quote: Tipping is not always expected in the Philippines especially since a mandatory "Service Charge" (8–12%) is added to a restaurant or hotel bill when issued

money.en: In bazaars and tiangges (markets) prices may be marked, but you can often bargain for a better price.
money.es: En bazares y tiangges (mercados) los precios pueden estar marcados, pero a menudo se puede regatear.
money.quote: In bazaars and tiangges (markets), prices may be marked, but you can often bargain for a better price.

money.en: Most of the 20,000 ATMs are connected to the local BancNet ATM network.
money.es: La mayoría de los 20.000 cajeros automáticos están conectados a la red local BancNet.
money.quote: Most of the 20,000 ATMs are connected to the local BancNet ATM network.

etiquette.en: Filipinos respect their elders, and it is considered rude to challenge what someone older has said.
etiquette.es: Los filipinos respetan a sus mayores y se considera grosero cuestionar lo que dice alguien mayor.
etiquette.quote: Filipinos respect their elders, and it is considered rude to challenge someone older than you has said.

etiquette.en: Take off your shoes when entering homes, unless your hosts say otherwise.
etiquette.es: Quítate los zapatos al entrar en una casa, a menos que los anfitriones digan lo contrario.
etiquette.quote: Take off your shoes when entering homes, unless your hosts say otherwise.

etiquette.en: Avoid shouting, raising your voice or losing your cool.
etiquette.es: Evita gritar, alzar la voz o perder la calma.
etiquette.quote: Avoid shouting, raising your voice, or losing your cool.

etiquette.en: Unless in a position of authority, avoid pointing out mistakes or expressing disagreement in front of everybody.
etiquette.es: A menos que tengas autoridad, evita señalar errores o expresar desacuerdo delante de todos.
etiquette.quote: Unless you are in a position of authority, avoid pointing out someone's mistakes or expressing disagreement in front of everybody.

etiquette.en: Kissing and hugging in public can offend Filipino sensitivities, while holding hands is acceptable.
etiquette.es: Besarse y abrazarse en público puede ofender la sensibilidad filipina, mientras que tomarse de la mano es aceptable.
etiquette.quote: In short, don't offend Filipino sensitivities by kissing and hugging in public. Holding hands, on the other hand, is acceptable

etiquette.en: Always say thank you or salamat when receiving something.
etiquette.es: Di siempre gracias o salamat al recibir algo.
etiquette.quote: Always say "thank you" or salamat when receiving something.

connectivity.en: Since December 2022, prepaid SIM cards, including tourist SIMs, must be registered before use.
connectivity.es: Desde diciembre de 2022 es obligatorio registrar las tarjetas SIM de prepago, incluidas las SIM turísticas, antes de usarlas.
connectivity.quote: Since December 2022, registration is mandatory before you can use a prepaid SIM card, which also includes tourist SIMs commonly offered at airport arrivals areas.

connectivity.en: Prepaid SIM cards for foreign visitors automatically expire within 30 days, though this can be extended for long-term stays with documentation.
connectivity.es: Las SIM de prepago para visitantes extranjeros caducan a los 30 días, aunque se puede ampliar en estancias largas con documentación.
connectivity.quote: Prepaid SIM cards for foreign visitors automatically expire within 30 days, but that can be extended if you are on a long-term stay by providing additional documentation as proof.

connectivity.en: Two major companies operate the GSM networks: Globe Telecom and Smart Communications.
connectivity.es: Dos grandes empresas operan las redes GSM: Globe Telecom y Smart Communications.
connectivity.quote: There are two major companies operating GSM 900/1800 networks: Globe Telecom and Smart Communications.

connectivity.en: LTE and 5G are available through all providers, but service may get spotty outside urban areas.
connectivity.es: LTE y 5G están disponibles con todos los operadores, pero el servicio puede ser irregular fuera de zonas urbanas.
connectivity.quote: LTE and 5G technology is available through all providers, but service may get spotty outside urban areas.

connectivity.en: Most popular websites and web services should be accessible in the Philippines.
connectivity.es: La mayoría de los sitios web y servicios en línea populares deberían ser accesibles en Filipinas.
connectivity.quote: Most popular websites and web services should be accessible in the Philippines.
